description: VU_ASTRAVIA — The Journey Through Space is an immersive space simulation where players become astronauts, explore new worlds, face realistic challenges, conduct missions, and make decisions that shape their journey.
summary:
ASTRAVIA is an educational space-exploration game developed by Team VU Astravia, inspired by NASA missions and informed by publicly available NASA data. It is designed to let players customize astronauts, assemble spacecraft, navigate missions, land on planetary surfaces, and collect scientific samples. Mission objectives, limited resources, and progression encourage players to plan carefully, solve problems, and learn through exploration.

The game addresses the gap between learning about space and experiencing the decisions behind a mission. By turning space science into engaging activities, ASTRAVIA aims to make complex concepts more accessible to students and curious learners. Our next step is to complete development and launch the game online, bringing interactive space learning to a worldwide audience.
details:
ASTRAVIA is an educational space-exploration game developed by Team VU Astravia. It connects curiosity about space with learning through mission preparation, exploration, and problem-solving, drawing on publicly available NASA data and mission resources.

The game is designed around a complete mission journey. Players customize their astronaut’s suit, helmet, colors, and backpack, then assemble a spacecraft using engines, fuel tanks, a crew capsule, and scientific equipment. Simple explanations introduce each component’s purpose and help players understand how their choices affect fuel, power, and mission readiness.

A connected map organizes ten levels inspired by NASA missions. Players review objectives, prepare equipment, and begin their journey. The intended gameplay includes steering the spacecraft, adjusting thrust, monitoring fuel, and landing safely. After landing, players control their astronaut to walk, run, jump, explore, collect samples, deploy instruments, and return discoveries to the spacecraft.

Progress depends on completing every required objective. Successful missions award coins and unlock further challenges. Coins support equipment and suit upgrades, while unsuccessful attempts allow players to retry and improve their preparation. Mission Control guidance helps beginners understand tasks and manage supplies.

ASTRAVIA combines astronaut customization, spacecraft construction, and scientific exploration within one learning experience. Our design priorities include accessible controls, clear objectives, readable interfaces, consistent characters, and a balance between scientific inspiration and enjoyable gameplay. Historical mission inspiration is distinguished from fictional training scenarios.

We used Google Flow to generate background videos, ChatGPT to generate images, and Antigravity for coding assistance. These tools supported our development and visual presentation.

Our intended impact is to make space science more approachable for students and curious learners while encouraging planning, experimentation, and persistence. Development is ongoing. Our next steps are to improve controls and mission interactions, expand educational content, test with users, and release the complete game online for learners worldwide.
